body.message:
This is a final notice.

Following your continued delay and failure to process the refund, this matter has now been formally escalated to Dubai Tourism and Dubai Land Department.

Your position is inconsistent and unsupported:
- your own inspection on March 18 reported no pest-related issues,
- all pest complaints were raised during the stay and were never resolved by your team,
- the “bed bugs” claim was introduced only after check-out and is clearly a post-factum attempt to justify withholding funds.

For the avoidance of doubt, we do not accept any deductions.

You are required to proceed with the full refund immediately:
- unused nights (March 6–19),
- full security deposit (AED 5,000).

Failure to resolve this immediately will result in:
- formal continuation of regulatory proceedings,
- escalation with full documentation of unsafe living conditions (including exposure of a family with newborn children to pests),
- and additional claims for damages.

Please confirm today the exact transfer date.

This is your final opportunity to resolve the matter amicably.
